0bb1f00e9ce5: How does Travelife help me launch a high-performing B2C travel website?
3589761c40d7: Travelife provides a turnkey e-commerce solution designed specifically for consumer sales. With our drag-and-drop Experience CMS, you set up a showcase and e-commerce website without any coding skills, handling the entire customer journey: from searching dynamic offers to secure checkout.
68cea47e7875: What exactly does the setup fee cover?
55dbfb55de77: This one-time fee ensures your B2C environment runs flawlessly: it covers the deployment of your dedicated cloud services, initialization of production databases, configuration of your security protocols, and technical support during your website launch.
57c08157a584: Does the pricing include commissions on my online sales?
06ebba737550: No. Travelife's philosophy is to protect your profitability. We take no commission on the business generated through your B2C website. You pay a clear, fixed monthly subscription, giving you full control over your operating budget.
2af1adb0c244: How much does a travel agency website cost with Travelife?
2570ecaa28bf: A travel agency website from Travelife costs 99 € per month on the Starter plan (500 € setup) and 399 € per month on the Advanced plan (1,500 € setup). The Premium / Enterprise plan, designed for large companies and agency networks, is available on quote. For the Starter plan, the highly recommended Turnkey Launch Pack adds the upload of your 10 flagship tours for 300 €. No commission is charged on your online sales.
f076dd39df1b: What is the difference between the Starter, Advanced and Premium plans?
2b2f2fb38b58: The Starter plan is for local agencies and DMCs that sell their own products, without external APIs: full CMS, direct hotel contracts, tours & activities, forms and blog, on a shared cloud server with standard support (email / ticket). The Advanced plan, the core offer for outbound agencies and OTAs, adds the Packages module, 2 included APIs (1 hotel + 1 flight), an optimized cloud server and priority support. The Premium / Enterprise plan offers unlimited access to the global API hub, dedicated servers and 24/7 VIP support.
69b7ffbd3c3f: Can I easily upgrade my subscription plan?
f878eb523084: Absolutely. The platform is built to scale. You can start with 100% local, in-house products (Starter plan) and move up to a higher plan (Advanced or Enterprise) as soon as you decide to add API connectors or expand your distribution networks.
1bc5086dac26: Can I sell both my own trips and third-party API products?
691fa375e9d1: Yes, that is the key strength of our hybrid architecture. Our platform lets you load your own hotel contracts, excursions and tours directly (Production Engine) while pulling in feeds from global wholesalers via API (Hotelbeds, Travelgate, Amadeus, Air Arabia). Your customers combine everything in a single cart.
7a963e2221b0: Is the B2C website optimized for search engines (SEO)?
9a9e1c3e5d6d: Absolutely. The technical structure strictly meets Google's speed requirements (Core Web Vitals). You have full control over meta titles, descriptions and URL structures. In addition, a native Blog section helps you capture organic traffic on your strategic keywords.
a2f2e18a6530: How do margin and rate management (yield management) work?
d3d5cbcd5756: From your unified back office, you have full control over your pricing policies. You can apply automatic markup rules as a percentage or fixed amount by API supplier, destination, product or season, and configure booking fees that are either shown to the buyer or built into the price.
d723002e2154: What payment methods are available to end customers?
2b32a0cb599f: Travelife integrates natively with the leading secure online payment gateways (local and international bank cards). You can set flexible collection rules: full payment at purchase, an online deposit with automated balance management, or a simple quote request.
8b616216dd58: Can I connect my travel agency website to Amadeus, Sabre or Hotelbeds?
ae6d7e15dd3f: Yes, from the Advanced plan upward. This plan includes 2 APIs of your choice (1 hotel feed and 1 flight feed, for example Air Arabia or Kyte), with full mapping and testing performed by Travelife, excluding supplier credential fees. The Premium / Enterprise plan provides unlimited access to the global API hub: Amadeus, Sabre and Galileo GDSs, Travelgate, Hotelbeds, Webbeds, Jumbobeds, TBO and other bed banks. The Starter plan is limited to local, in-house products, with no external APIs.
2980dbb2c8f9: What training is included with my travel agency website?
89a14d8283a2: Training depends on the plan. The Starter plan's Launch Pack includes 2 hours of online training, in addition to domain setup, logo integration and basic brand guidelines. The Advanced plan includes 6 to 8 hours of initial training, plus custom setup of your pricing rules. With the drag-and-drop CMS, your teams can then create and edit their pages without any coding skills.
a30fcac07603: Can I see an example of a travel agency website built with Travelife?
0585013ec9f4: Yes. Travelife provides a B2C demo site so you can explore the booking journey exactly as your customers will see it, from searching offers to booking. You can also request a personalized demo via the website request form or by calling (+212) 5 21 50 06 05 to see how your own catalog and direct contracts would be presented.
9b10701b8578: Can I get my data back if I leave?
c8e6213cb692: Your customer data, rate sheets and booking history remain your exclusive property. We guarantee complete, transparent data portability through structured export options for all of your databases.
4d6f4a35199c: Are updates to the e-commerce solution included?
7b664756dc0b: Yes. As a modern SaaS technology solution, all security patches, supplier API connector maintenance and new CMS features are rolled out fully automatically and seamlessly, with no interruption for your customers.
92e20755eea3: Power your business with a custom-built website. Our e-commerce solution lets you launch a high-performing, modern travel agency website fully connected to global APIs to win customers and automate your bookings.
